degree_rationale: How Adam and Eve were molded by Saklas/Nebroel after the heavenly image — the Ambassador revealed to Hyle, who imprinted his icon in her offspring; the parable of the noble free woman whose face is hidden. Treats the inner mechanism of how heaven's image was received and copied below.
direction_rationale: Inward processing of the begetting through cosmic 'lust' for the image — the inward heart of the soul receiving and imprinting. Reflective-comparative through the noble-woman parable.
grand_man_function: Spiritual image-reception — how cosmos received the divine image into its lust.
title: How Adam and Eve were molded by Saklas and Nebroel after the heavenly image
